snippet.title: I Write Games Not Tragedies - A Game by Studio Wife & Cornmandog
snippet.description:
Wishlist I Write Games Not Tragedies - The Emo-inspired rhythm game/visual novel on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3396670/I_Write_Games_Not_Tragedies/

A narrative-driven rhythm game that pays homage to the emo and goth subcultures, I Write Games Not Tragedies explores the concept of catharsis through humour and (loud) music. Scream with Ash as he makes the transition from baby bat to elder emo, guide him through his growing pains, and help him navigate his problematic dirtbag life through music.

Music:
'Black' by Megan Valentine - https://youtu.be/dI7K6d4-SIU

'Nommunication' by The Lonely Harps Club - https://youtu.be/zJ7NrE0HSDk

'Date Night' by kzar - https://soundcloud.com/user-196440554/date-night?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium...

'Sweat Out Your Tears' by GUTTY - https://soundcloud.com/gutterash/sweat-out-your-tears-all-the-pizzas-feel-wrong?...
